errors.text_span: PW (light green with a bold dark green border), R (pale yellow), RW (pale yellow with a bold dark yellow border), N (light blue), and NW (light blue with a bold dark blue border)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the colors of the 'W' categories. It claims PW, RW, and NW are bordered versions of the P, R, and N slices. In reality, the legend and charts show they are separate categories with their own distinct solid colors: PW is dark green, RW is dark yellow/brown, and NW is dark blue.

errors.text_span: Visually, all slices in both charts are exploded, meaning they are slightly offset from the center.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Only the slices corresponding to the 'W' categories (PW, RW, NW) are exploded. The slices for P, R, and N are not offset from the center.
